POSITION PURPOSE:
The Director of Insights and Analytics will lead the development and execution of data-driven strategies that enhance our business performance and customer engagement. This role encompasses Business Analytics, Sales Forecasting, Consumer Insights, Customer Care Center operations, Pricing Analytics, Marketing and Loyalty Analytics, and Budget Management. The ideal candidate is a visionary leader who can motivate and empower a high-functioning team to achieve ambitious goals and support the company’s growth objectives.
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business Analytics: Develop and oversee comprehensive business analytics strategies to inform decision-making across all levels of the organization. Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable insights to drive revenue, profitability, customer loyalty, and operational efficiency
Sales Forecasting: Lead the sales forecasting process, utilizing historical data and market trends to create accurate and reliable forecasts. Ownership of the forecasting model and accountability for refining the model as needed to ensure accuracy.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and support in achieving sales targets.
Consumer Insights: Oversight of consumer insights and research, leading an consumer insights team that conducts in-depth consumer research to identify brand metrics, trends, preferences, and behaviors. Utilize insights to inform product development, marketing strategies, loyalty programs, and customer experience enhancements.
Customer Care Center: Lead the Customer Experience Team responsible for our Customer Care Center operations. Develop systems and processes that enable high levels of service and customer satisfaction. Work closely with the Integrated Marketing team to ensure that scripts are brand appropriate. Manage vendors, balancing effective tools with overall platform costs.  Leverage data to improve customer experience and unit-level operations.
Pricing Analytics: Develop and implement pricing strategies based on market analysis and competitive intelligence. Monitor price sensitivity and performance to optimize revenue and profitability. Manage a third-party pricing consultant across company and franchise locations.
Marketing and Loyalty Analytics: Analyze the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and loyalty programs. Utilize test and learn strategies to unearth incrementality and impact. Provide insights to enhance customer retention, engagement, and overall brand loyalty.
Budget Management: Manage the Advertising Fund, ensuring optimal allocation of resources. Collaborate with finance and other departments to track spending and maximize ROI on analytics initiatives.
Analytics and Insights Leadership: Work closely with the CEO, CFO, and other Executive Leaders to provide timely insights into business performance, macro trends, and competitive insights.
Business Planning: Actively participate in annual planning to shape the company Annual Operating Plan (AOP), and prepare materials for business meetings throughout the year, including Board of Directors and Earnings Calls. 
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing analytics team. Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, empowering team members to achieve their full potential.
Budget Oversight:

Direct Responsibility: $1-2M
Indirect Responsibility: $45-55M

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
15+ years of experience in analytics, preferably within the restaurant or retail industries.
Proven leadership experience, with a track record of managing and developing high-performing teams.

License/Certifications: N/A

Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and statistical analysis software (e.g., R, Python).

Strategic thinker with a results-oriented mindset and the ability to drive change.

jobPostings.jobDescription:
Job Summary
This role owns El Pollo Loco’s recipe and food inventory systems and serves as the single source of truth for recipe and inventory data. The Manager keeps that data accurate, turns it into insights that improve food cost and profitability, and makes sure menu items are built and maintained consistently across all El Pollo Loco locations.
Key Focus Areas

Data cleanup and integrity
Recipe and prep optimization
Actual vs. theoretical variance analysis
System maintenance and new item setup
Vendor integration (Supply Chain partners/vendors)
Operations and franchise partner support
Reporting cleanup, access management, and analytics

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
Data Integrity

Audit recipe and inventory data to find and fix inconsistencies, errors, and outdated entries.
Clean the recipe database: remove duplicates, standardize formatting, and verify ingredient quantities across all locations.
Clean inventory data: fix discrepancies, standardize units of measure, and archive inactive items.
Monitor data daily so small errors don’t compound.

Cost Control & Profitability

Keep recipe costing current in Recipe & Food Inventory System, updating for vendor price changes.
Standardize portion sizes, build efficient prep schedules, and roll out digital checklists to reduce waste.
Calculate actual vs. theoretical food cost and find root causes of loss, such as portioning, spoilage, or theft.
Implement new platform features that improve ordering, waste tracking, and food cost performance.

Supply Chain & Operations

Own new item and recipe setup, with clear protocols for accurate and timely entry, working with Supply Chain and Culinary.
Support consistent inventory practices at restaurants, including physical counts, FIFO/FEFO, and usage-rate monitoring to right-size stock levels.
Manage the Supply Chain partners/vendors integration: secure FTP data exchange, GDSN product data and images, and troubleshooting of transmission errors.

Operations Partnership

Act as the go-to resource for company and franchise operators on recipe & food inventory system questions, data validation, and system inquiries.
Work with restaurant teams to troubleshoot recipe, inventory, and costing issues, and resolve them quickly.
Validate operator-reported discrepancies against system data and follow through on corrections.
Gather operator feedback to improve system setup, training, and day-to-day usability.

Reporting & Platform Administration

Audit and clean up existing reports: retire outdated or duplicate reports and consolidate the rest into a clear, usable set.
Streamline the data points operations sees so restaurant and field leaders get the metrics that matter, without clutter.
Manage platform access and user roles so company, franchise, and corporate users have the right access levels, and review them regularly as people change roles.
Build and maintain food cost, variance, and inventory reports for Operations, Finance, and franchise partners.
Spot trends and opportunities, and bring clear, actionable recommendations to leadership.

Qualifications

3–5 years of restaurant back-office experience in inventory, costing, or finance; multi-unit QSR preferred.
Hands-on experience with food management systems (e.g., CrunchTime, Restaurant365).
Proven track record of data cleanup and data integrity work.
Working knowledge of FTP (File Transfer Protocol), GDSN (Global Data Synchronization Network), and POS systems; advanced Excel.
Experience supporting field or franchise operators, with the ability to explain technical issues in plain language.
Analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive, with strong communication skills.
Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, hospitality, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.

POSITION PURPOSE:
The Senior Director, Quality Assurance owns El Pollo Loco's enterprise quality assurance function end to end, consolidating vendor-level quality assurance and regulatory food safety compliance into a single point of accountability. This role is responsible for the integrity of the supply chain's quality systems — from supplier and co-manufacturer qualification through regulatory compliance across federal, state, and local agencies — and serves as the primary quality and food safety resource to the franchise system.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Vendor & Supplier Quality Assurance

Directs vendor and supplier quality assurance programs across El Pollo Loco's poultry portfolio, including fresh leg quarters (“Saddles”) and value-added further-processed chicken items, ensuring specification integrity, ingredient consistency, and product quality at every stage of the supply chain.
Leads vendor qualification, audit, scorecarding, and corrective-action programs; partners with Procurement and Distribution to resolve quality holds, non-conformances, and supplier performance issues.
Owns quality specifications for co-manufactured and further-processed chicken products, working directly with processors to validate manufacturing controls, shelf-life, and food safety design prior to system-wide rollout.
Evaluates and approves new vendors, ingredients, and product formulations, ensuring alignment with brand quality standards and regulatory requirements.

Regulatory & Food Safety Compliance

Serves as the company's senior point of accountability for food safety regulatory compliance, including FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GFSI, and state and local health department requirements across all operating jurisdictions.
Builds and maintains direct working relationships with state and federal regulatory agencies; leads the company's response to regulatory inquiries, inspections, and enforcement actions.
Owns crisis management, product withdrawal, and recall protocols (including activation of the Level 3 Withdrawal Process), partnering with executive leadership and legal counsel as needed.
Directs internal and third-party food safety audit programs spanning restaurants, distribution centers, and manufacturing partners.

Team Leadership & Franchise Support

Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization spanning both vendor quality and regulatory food safety disciplines; sets performance expectations, coaching plans, and succession pipelines for direct reports.
Serves as a critical QA partner to the franchise system, delivering training, technical guidance, and responsive support to franchisees on quality and food safety matters.
Represents Quality Assurance in cross-functional and executive leadership forums, translating vendor and regulatory risk into clear, actionable guidance for Operations and senior leadership.
Other duties as assigned by the SVP, Supply Chain & Quality Assurance.

QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
Education/Work Experience:
BA/BS in Food Science, Food Microbiology, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred. Minimum 12+ years of progressive quality assurance and food safety experience, with substantial, direct experience in poultry and value-added/further-processed chicken products required. Demonstrated background working directly with state and federal regulatory agencies (FDA, USDA, state health departments) on compliance, inspections, or enforcement matters required. Prior experience directly managing and developing a quality assurance team required.
License/Certifications:
Valid driver's license required. HACCP certification required; PCQI (Preventive Controls Qualified Individual) preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Proven track record building, managing, and developing high-performing quality assurance teams, with strong people-leadership, coaching, and succession-planning skills.
Deep working knowledge of value-added and further-processed chicken manufacturing, including co-manufacturer oversight, specification management, and shelf-life validation.
Established credibility with state and federal regulatory agencies; skilled at navigating inspections, audits, and enforcement proceedings with composure and precision.
Demonstrated ability to support and train franchisees on quality and food safety standards, balancing brand protection with practical, field-level guidance.
Confidence in execution of strategic initiatives; decisive and able to make fact-based decisions under pressure.
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset and skills; meticulous attention to detail.
Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external business partners, including vendors, regulators, and franchisees.
Ability to prioritize and plan competing, time-sensitive work assignments under frequent, tight deadlines.
Ability to read, write, and interpret complex regulatory reports, contracts, and correspondence.
Ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significant risk and consequence to the company.
Ability to work weekends and extended work schedules as needed.
Willing and able to travel locally within Southern California and to out-of-state vendor, distribution, and restaurant locations, as needed, by car or airplane.

POSITION PURPOSE:
The Senior Data Engineer owns El Pollo Loco's (EPL) loyalty and customer spend data, turning it into reliable, actionable insight for leadership. This role starts with the business problem: understanding what decision leadership needs to make, then independently designing and delivering the data solution that supports it. The engineer owns data domains end to end, from source ingestion and architecture through reporting and analysis, and ensures data integrity across internal systems and external partners. Working directly with business departments, internal technology teams, and external technology vendors, this role drives architectural improvements that directly shape how EPL leadership makes decisions.
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business Problem Framing: Partner with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and leadership to understand business questions, translate them into data requirements, and recommend the right solution approach without needing detailed direction.
Independent Solution Design: Own solutions from concept to production, including evaluating options, making architectural trade-off decisions, and delivering working outcomes with minimal supervision.
Data Domain Ownership: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines, ingestion flows, and analytical models for loyalty, customer, and transaction data.
Architecture & Governance: Define and own data architecture for the domain, ensuring alignment with business needs, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.
Vendor & Partner Collaboration: Work directly with external technology vendors and data providers (loyalty, POS, digital ordering, and marketing platforms) to define integrations, resolve data issues, and hold partners accountable for data quality and delivery.
Data Contracts & Integration: Establish data contracts with internal and external sources, integrate new data sources, and develop reusable transformation patterns.
Pipeline Reliability & Optimization: Identify limitations in existing data processes, drive improvements, and establish best practices, including automated monitoring, alerting, and self-healing processing.
AI/ML Integration: Apply AI/ML technologies, including large language models and agentic frameworks, to expand analytics capabilities and automate insight generation.
Innovation & Scalability: Modernize ingestion frameworks and build secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions that support EPL's growth.

 
QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job.  Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.  The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.  
 
QUALIFICATIONS:

8+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, or analytics engineering, including ownership of production data platforms.
Expert-level SQL and strong experience with modern ETL/ELT practices and data processing.
Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouse platforms (e.g., Snowflake or comparable).


Experience with data governance and data modeling to ensure data integrity as analytics and reports are developed across EPL.


Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous business problem and independently design, build, and deliver a solution.
Experience managing integrations and working relationships with third-party technology vendors.
Experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks, and the ability to integrate AI into analytics workflows.
Experience with loyalty, customer, or transactional data in restaurant, retail, or consumer businesses is strongly preferred.

 
LEADERSHIP & BUSINESS SKILLS:

Technical leadership mindset with a long-term architectural vision and a commitment to high-quality delivery.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and setting direction where none exists.
Strong judgment in balancing short-term needs against long-term business goals.
Communicates clearly in business terms with executives and non-technical stakeholders.
Sense of urgency and strong attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

 
IMPACT:This is a strategic role. The engineer will directly influence how EPL leadership makes decisions by ensuring customer and loyalty data is available, accurate, and actionable.
 
EDUCATION:

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

POSITION PURPOSE:
The Sr. Manager, Field Training leads El Pollo Loco’s field-based training function and is accountable for the consistent execution, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of restaurant training across company and franchise operations. This role leads, coaches, and develops the field training team, including the Restaurant Opening function, while partnering closely with Operations and Training leadership to build restaurant and leadership capability.
As the senior field training leader, this role sets expectations for training quality, field execution, leadership development, and operational readiness across markets. The Sr. Manager, Field Training ensures Certified Training Restaurants (CTRs), Certified Training General Managers (GTMs), management training, new restaurant openings, franchise training, and company program rollouts are delivered to a consistent standard and produce measurable business results.
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead and Develop the Field Training Team
•  Lead, coach, develop, and manage the performance of Field Training Managers,  Restaurant Opening Leaders, and other assigned training roles.
•  Set clear expectations, priorities, performance standards, and development plans for the field training team; recognize strong performance and address gaps promptly.
•  Establish a consistent field training strategy and operating rhythm across markets, balancing restaurant openings, management training, franchise support, program rollouts, and operational training needs.
•  Conduct regular field observations and provide real-time coaching and feedback to field training leaders on training execution, leadership presence, business judgment, and partnership with Operations.
•  Build bench strength and succession readiness within the field training team through onboarding, coaching, development, and stretch assignments.
•  Allocate field training resources based on business priorities, market needs, opening complexity, and team capability.
 
Own Field Training Programs and Standards
•  Provide strategic oversight of the Certified Training Restaurant (CTR) and Certified Training General Manager (GTM) programs, including certification standards, audits, performance expectations, and continuous improvement.
•  Ensure management training programs for SLITs, MITs, and other restaurant leaders are executed consistently and that transition meetings and handoffs establish clear expectations for continued development.
•  Evaluate the effectiveness of field training programs, training restaurants, facilitators, tools, and learning experiences; identify trends and implement improvements.
•  Partner with Training and Operations to identify capability and skill gaps and develop field-based solutions, leadership classes, workshops, coaching plans, and other interventions.
•  Ensure training records, certifications, trainee progress, program assessments, and field follow-up are accurate, timely, and actionable.
•  Maintain strong knowledge of El Pollo Loco operating procedures, training programs, and industry best practices, translating field insights into recommendations for improvement.
 
Lead New Restaurant Opening and Franchise Training Execution
•  Provide leadership and oversight for the Restaurant Opening team and new restaurant opening training strategy, ensuring openings are staffed, supported, and executed to established training and operational standards.
•  Directly supervise and develop the Sr. Restaurant Opening Leader, ensuring the Restaurant Opening Leader team is effectively deployed, coached, and prepared for the opening pipeline.
•  Partner with Operations, Training, HR, Facilities, and other cross-functional teams to forecast opening needs and ensure training readiness across staffing, systems, food safety, compliance, leadership capability, and operational execution.
•  Ensure lessons learned and best practices from new restaurant openings and restaurant stabilizations are captured and incorporated into field training tools, standards, and playbooks.
•  Oversee training support for new and existing franchise operators and new-market franchise restaurant openings, ensuring alignment with EPL standards and effective partnership with franchise leadership.
 
Drive Company Program Rollouts and Field Execution
•  Partner with Training, Operations, and cross-functional leaders to plan and execute company training rollouts, ensuring field leaders understand the program, can coach it effectively, and drive restaurant-level adoption.
•  Provide field perspective and subject matter expertise during the design and development of training programs, materials, manuals, visual aids, eLearning scripts, videos, knowledge assessments, and implementation tools.
•  Establish field feedback loops to assess adoption, identify execution barriers, and recommend adjustments that improve training effectiveness and operational results.
•  Consult with Operations leaders to prioritize field training needs and deploy the team against the highest-impact opportunities.
 
Build Strong Cross-Functional Partnerships and Accountability
•  Serve as the primary field training partner to Operations leadership, regularly communicating training performance, restaurant capability needs, opening readiness, risks, and recommended actions.
•  Use observations, audits, trainee results, restaurant performance indicators, and stakeholder feedback to assess training effectiveness and guide decisions.
•  Ensure all field training programs and activities support company standards for food safety, workplace safety, hygiene, timekeeping, legal compliance, and EPL STRONG Values.
•  Model a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning, Loco Love, and high standards in every interaction with restaurant teams, franchise partners, and support-center partners.
•  Perform other activities, duties, or responsibilities as assigned by the Sr. Director, Training.
 
QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The requirements below are representative of the education, experience, knowledge, and capabilities required.
 
Education/Work Experience:
•  High School diploma required; BA/BS in Business Administration, Hospitality, Learning & Development, or a related field preferred.
•  Progressive restaurant operations and field training experience required, including experience leading and developing leaders across multiple restaurants or markets.
•  Prior experience managing direct reports and leading a field-based team required.
•  Demonstrated experience with restaurant management training, Certified Training Restaurant programs, new restaurant openings, franchise training, or comparable multi-unit training programs strongly preferred.
•  Strong restaurant operations background with the credibility to coach General Managers, Area Leaders, franchise operators, and other field leaders.
 
License/Certifications:
•  Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license.
•  ServSafe certification required.
 
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
•  Proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold other leaders accountable for results.
•  Strong knowledge of adult learning, field training, on-the-job coaching, classroom facilitation, and eLearning application.
•  Ability to translate business priorities and operational performance gaps into practical training strategies and field execution plans.
•  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to use data and field observations to identify trends and recommend action.
•  Excellent communication and influencing skills with the ability to build credibility with Operations, franchise partners, restaurant leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.
•  Strong planning, organization, and resource-management skills; ability to prioritize competing, time-sensitive needs across multiple markets.
•  Ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significance to the company and confidently make fact-based decisions.
•  High level of proficiency with technology, including Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, learning and database applications, and digital collaboration tools.
•  Ability to work weekends and extended schedules as business needs require.
•  Ability to travel frequently to company and franchise restaurant locations, including out-of-state travel by car or airplane.

POSITION PURPOSE:
The Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative, operational, and logistical support to one or more company executives and their corresponding leadership teams. This role serves as a trusted partner, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations, effective communication, coordination with senior staff members  and is a professional representation of the company to internal and external stakeholders. 
 
Due to the nature of the work—including in-person executive support, coordination of company visitors, handling confidential materials, and execution of special projects—this position requires a minimum of four (4) days per week working on-site. Regular in-office presence is an essential function of the role. Remote work is complementary and does not replace the required in-office presence necessary to fulfill the essential functions of this role.
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Provide real-time, administrative support to executive(s), including calendar management, meeting coordination, note taking, recording of action items, expense reporting, composing and preparing correspondence, arranging complex and detailed travel, and urgent day-of schedule changes.

Support special projects that require in-person collaboration, coordination, and follow-through with executive leadership and partner teams.
Provide a bridge for smooth communication between the executive’s office and internal departments, demonstrating leadership to maintain credibility, trust and support with senior management.
Coordinate closely with other Executive Assistants and functional teams as needed on in-office matters impacting executive leadership, including handling temporary work overloads and providing administrative coverage or back-up support for other executives or departments when needed.
Plans and leads 10-15 Meetings throughout the year. 
Manages field hierarchy alignment documents and communication with the organization
Provides reporting, budgeting, and invoice support to executives
Handle highly confidential and sensitive information requiring secure, controlled, and professional in-office management.
Support executive discussions and documentation that necessitate discretion and limited access.

POSITION PURPOSE:
The Senior Graphic Designer serves as the design team's day-to-day creative execution lead and a creative thought partner to the Senior Manager. Taking art direction and base design elements from the Senior Manager of Graphic Design, this role leads the development of complete, high-fidelity asset systems across digital, print, social, and in-restaurant channels. Beyond execution, the Senior Graphic Designer contributes original ideas and design perspectives during ideation and concepting, pushing beyond only fulfilling the brief. As both a hands-on designer and a project leader, this role produces senior-level creative work on priority initiatives, serves as a trusted resource and project leader for the design team, building out full campaign asset suites, and partnering with cross-functional teams and external agencies to bring brand campaigns to life on time and on brand. Receiving creative direction and partnering with the Senior Manager, Graphic Design.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
 

Lead the end-to-end execution of major creative initiatives, creating new design directions and translating exiting design elements into complete, high-fidelity asset systems across digital, print, social, and in-restaurant channels.
Produce high-fidelity design work for priority brand campaigns, key initiatives, and elevated creative that requires senior-level craft.
Serve as a trusted resource for the design team, offering feedback and technique expertise when needed to help them hone meticulous, high-quality execution. Provide project leadership across campaign work in flight, ensuring quality, consistency, and brand adherence across the team's output.
Working alongside the design team to build out the complete range of adaptations, resizes, and channel-specific creative from established concepts.
Serve as a creative thought partner to the Senior Manager and design team during ideation and concepting, contributing original ideas, creative perspectives, and design recommendations that push the work forward and elevate campaign concepts beyond the initial brief.
Serve as a day-to-day project lead on creative work in flight, managing timelines, deliverables, stakeholder feedback, revisions, and cross-functional coordination.
Partner with marketing, product, communications, and other internal stakeholders to translate briefs into creative solutions and deliver integrated campaigns on time and on brand.
Collaborate with external creative and production agencies on projects that require partner support, ensuring seamless integration, quality control, and consistent brand execution.
Serve as a day-to-day steward of brand consistency.
Act as a dependable source of design knowledge the team can lean on for guidance on technique, tools, and production workflow, elevating the collective craft of the design team over time.
Stay informed about advancements in design tools, AI capabilities, and industry trends, applying them to elevate the team's creative output and streamline production.
Other activities, duties or responsibilities that are assigned by your supervisor.

Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
Education/Work Experience:
BA/BS degree in Graphic Design, or similar educational experience in Design or related field. 5+ years of design experience with progressive responsibility, ideally in restaurant, retail, or multi-unit concepts with frequent product launches and concurrent campaigns throughout the year. Demonstrated experience leading creative execution end-to-end, from concept through delivery. Prior experience providing craft feedback, project leadership, and technical guidance to more junior designers (without formal people-management responsibility) is required. Client-side or agency experience welcomed.
License/Certifications:
Possess and maintain a valid driver's license.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
 

Exceptional design skills with a portfolio demonstrating high-fidelity, impactful creative work across multiple mediums including digital, print, social, and campaign work.
Mastery of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), with a strong understanding of print production, color management, prepress, and file preparation across digital and print destinations.
Experience with motion graphics and video (After Effects, Premiere Pro) is a plus but not required.
Strong understanding of design principles, typography, color theory, layout, and brand systems.
Ability to take art direction and base design elements from a design leader and expand them into complete, on-brand asset systems across multiple formats and channels.
Comfortable serving as a trusted design resource, sharing technique expertise and feedback when needed, without owning formal responsibility for their development.
A creative-forward mindset. Comfortable both executing against clear direction AND contributing original ideas, alternative perspectives, and creative recommendations during ideation. Pushes the work rather than only fulfilling the brief.
Strong project management skills, comfortable owning multiple concurrent projects, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships in a fast-moving in-house creative environment.

POSITION PURPOSE:
The Restaurant Opening Leader is a leader assigned to New Restaurant Openings to model elite General Manager performance and establish operational excellence from Day 1.  This role does not replace the permanent GM at new restaurant openings — it elevates them through targeted focus and support. 
 
The Restaurant Opening Leader sets the cultural tone, demonstrates ownership, accountability, and STRONG Values in action, and builds the capability of the incoming leadership team before transitioning the restaurant to its permanent leader. This role requires availability of travelling extensively and for long consecutive durations of time.
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
 
The Restaurant Opening Leader will be responsible for both opening new restaurants and stabilizing at-risk restaurants. When not opening new restaurants, the Restaurant Opening Leader will support stabilizing Field Operations with restaurants and Managers (at all levels) in need of support and guidance in achieving company goals. 
 
Model Best-In-Class Leadership

Lead on-site operational execution for all phases of restaurant development from pre-opening, training, opening, and through stabilization.
Partner with Operations, Training, HR, and Facilities to ensure readiness in staffing, systems, food safety, and compliance.
Conduct hands-on modeling of standards.
Demonstrate what strong labor deployment, food cost control, and operational discipline look like.
Coach and model how to lead with urgency and accountability.
Coach and model to protect company assets and uphold EPL STRONG Values in all environments.
Coach and model how to hold leaders to standards respectfully but firmly.
Coach and model timekeeping, food and workplace safety, and compliance discipline.

 
Establish Loco Love Culture

Coach and model Loco Love in every interaction with guests and team members.
Coach and model how hospitality should feel — not just be spoken about.
Demonstrate professional leadership presence.
Set expectations around communication, accountability, and teamwork.

 
Build the Permanent GM’s Capability

Coach all Managers in real time.
Coach and model team conversations, pre-shift meetings, team performance management, and recognition.
Provide feedback on leadership presence, operational judgment, and standards execution.
Transfer systems knowledge (ordering, inventory, scheduling, deployment).
Reinforce duty-to-report standards and escalate concerns immediately.
Ensure the permanent GM is confident and competent before handoff.

 
Leave Behind Structure

Confirm restaurant management team and team members understand compliance responsibilities.
Validate staffing readiness and role clarity.
Ensure labor, food cost, and inventory controls are executed precisely.
Ensure strict adherence to food safety, workplace safety, timekeeping, and break compliance.
Ensure systems are running correctly.

 
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
To perform this job successfully, the candidate must be in good standing with HR approval. Must have prior General Manager experience with El Pollo Loco, including:
 

Enthusiastic and positive demeanor, with a genuine passion for providing exceptional team and guest experiences. 
Strong communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills; ability to speak, write, and comprehend basic English. 
Strong coaching capability with proven ability to train new team members effectively.
Strong operational judgment and decision-making skills.
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of a shift and hold self and others accountable.
Demonstrated high performance. 
Certified in all restaurant positions.
Ability to lead confidently in unfamiliar or newly built environments.
Flexibility to work various shifts, including weekends and holidays. 
Commitment to upholding EPL values and standards of excellence.
Ability to travel 100% of the time.
